title: Inside Render with Anurag Goel, Founder & CEO: The $100M Raise at $1.5B Valuation
description:
Anurag Goel, Founder & CEO of Render (@render-inc ), sits down with Arthur Mouratov, Founding Partner at Silicon Valley Investclub, for an exclusive interview at Render's San Francisco office.

Render recently closed a $100M Series C extension at a $1.5B valuation, led by Georgian with participation from Addition, Bessemer Venture Partners, General Catalyst, and 01 Advisors — bringing total funding to $258M. With 5M+ developers on the platform, revenue growing over 100% year-over-year, and a team of 110+ people scaled with zero paid marketing, Render has become the modern application cloud competing directly with AWS, Google Cloud, and Vercel. In this interview, Anurag breaks down why he started Render in 2018 when "the market was closed," how Render became the default cloud for AI-native companies without ever calling itself an AI cloud, why he turned down the easier path after Stripe to solve infrastructure, and where Render is headed in the next 3 years.
